scenario_title: Transitioning at the end of a play session
minimal_context: The student is playing with plastic tracks and a motor car at the end of a 60-minute session and needs to transition out of the room.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Our 60 minutes are up. It is time to leave the session, so please put the plastic tracks and the motor car away.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops moving the car and stays back, watching instead of packing up. He goes into a shell and doesn't speak.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are you doing? You need to pack up your things so we can transition out of the room.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Avoids eye contact and looks down at his shaking legs.) I'm not feeling well.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We just need to go now. Please stand up and leave the toys on the table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts crying and becomes completely quiet and withdrawn, refusing to move.) Whenever it's time to leave I want to cry.

task.content: Transitioning out of the session after unstructured constructive play (e.g., a set of plastic tracks with a motor car that could move).
task.learning_goal: Successfully terminate the session and transition out.

context.materials: Visual expectations or rules, visual chart with time.
context.social_setting: Group setting with peers and facilitator.
context.time_context: At the end of a 60 min session.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When it is time to leave the session.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Wanting to cry due to the transition.
related_quotes: whenever it’s time to leave I want to cry

behavior_patterns.condition: When facing transitions or the end of a preferred structured environment.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Crying, not communicating, goes into a shell.
